mapper.select: SELECT col.id, col.resource_id, col.folder, col.created_at, r.title, r.type, r.visibility, r.download_count, c.name AS course_name, u.nickname AS uploader_name, f.file_name, f.file_size FROM collection col LEFT JOIN resource r ON r.id = col.resource_id LEFT JOIN course c ON c.id = r.course_id LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = r.uploader_id LEFT JOIN resource_version rv ON rv.id = r.current_version_id LEFT JOIN file f ON f.id = rv.file_id WHERE col.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY col.created_at DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{limit}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO collection (user_id, resource_id, folder, created_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{resourceId}, #{folder}, NOW())
